name: QUT International Merit Scholarship
summary: Ongoing 25% tuition fee scholarship for high-achieving international students starting an undergraduate or postgraduate course at QUT.
key: You'll receive an ongoing scholarship to cover 25% of your tuition fees per semester of study at QUT
who: Commencing the course for the first time
Eligibility is based only on your academic record
Not available if you hold another QUT academic scholarship
how: No application: QUT assesses you when you apply to study and includes the offer with your admission letter
catches: Continues for the course only while you keep meeting academic requirements

evidence.quote: You'll receive an ongoing scholarship to cover 25% of your tuition fees per semester of study at QUT
You do not need to apply for this scholarship.
